svg.title: Stabiliser column overhead and bottoms
svg.desc: Column C-201 with its overhead condenser, reflux drum and reflux pump, steam reboiler on the bottoms, product to storage; drawn to an example site profile. Drawing EX-PID-0201 revision B.
